spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (खजति)
To churn or agitate.
(इ,) खजि (खञ्जति)
To limp, to halt, to walk lame or ill.

m. (-जः)
A ladle, a spoon.
f. (-जा)
1 Churning, stirring.
2 Killing, destroying.
3 The palm with the fingers extended.
E.
खज to agitate, &c. affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
The churning stick.
f. (-जिका)
A ladle or spoon.
E.
खज to churn or agitate, affix ण्वुल्.

mf. (-कः-का)
A spoon, a ladle.
m. (-कः)
A bird.
E.
खज to agitate, and आक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-पः)
Ghee or clarified butter.
E.
खज to stir or agitate, Uṇādi affix अप.

n. (-लं)
1 Frost, hoar-frost.
2 Dew, rain.
E.
ख the sky, and जल water.

m. (जित्)
A Buddha, one of seven teachers or saints of the Buddha sect.
E.
ख heaven, and जित् who subdues.

m. (-तिः)
A fire-fly.
E.
ख, and ज्योतिस् light.

m. (-कः)
Fried or parched grain.
E.
खज to go, &c. affix ण्वुल्.
